folder.name: VV - OPTIONAL page_view readiness (OR, once per page)
folder.notes: Optional trigger set: attach VV - initial and VV - timer fallback 1s as two ordinary OR firing triggers to the existing Google tag (or explicit page_view tag), replacing its early trigger. Set Once per page. Do not use a trigger group (AND). May delay page_view by up to 1 s; fallback may have no class. Roll back by restoring the original trigger and firing option. Importing does not change site tags. See docs/ga4-reporting.md.

trigger.name: VV - agent
trigger.notes: Agent UI marker seen after the initial publication (detector 1.1.0): one escalation to declared_agent, before or after final.

trigger.name: VV - initial
trigger.notes: Optional page_view readiness set: use this OR VV - timer fallback 1s; set the existing site tag to Once per page. See folder notes.

trigger.name: VV - timer fallback 1s
trigger.notes: Optional page_view readiness set: use this OR VV - initial on the existing Google tag (or explicit page_view tag), Once per page. May delay page_view by up to 1 s. See folder notes for rollback. This import creates no Google tag.
